description: This file defines a FastAPI route handler for executing Python code snippets securely within a web application. It handles HTTP POST requests to run code, manages validation and security checks, interacts with database models to record execution details, and returns the runtime results.

classes.description: FastAPI's routing class, used to define route handlers.

classes.name: RunResult
classes.description: Schema representing the result of code execution, including stdout, stderr, exit code, duration, and timeout indicator.

classes.name: Execution
classes.description: Database model recording execution details such as code, output, and metadata.

classes.name: Snippet
classes.description: Database model representing code snippets owned by users.
